justification: Pure allocation-free composition of already-derived, selected-suite-bound TLS 1.3 traffic key and nonce state with repository-owned inner-plaintext, record-framing, and ChaCha20-Poly1305 primitives. It performs no filesystem, network, DNS, process, environment, clock, entropy, credential, signing, certificate, trust-root, path-validation, hostname, revocation, audit, HTTP, OAuth, or external effect.
